description: Configure state, hazard-class, and inspection filters to extract US dam inventory records from the USACE's official National Inventory of Dams.

hazardClass.description: Filter by the NID hazard potential classification published in the source data (High / Significant / Low). Dams classified Undetermined are included only under 'all'. The class describes the consequences if a dam failed; it is not a condition rating.
hazardClass.title: Hazard Potential Class

inspectionOverdue.description: Only dams with no recorded inspection date, or whose last recorded inspection was more than 5 years before the run date.
inspectionOverdue.title: Inspection Overdue (>5 Years or Never)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of dam records to extract.
maxItems.title: Max Dams

states.description: Two-letter US state / territory codes to include (e.g. ["DE", "TX"]), as published in the National Inventory of Dams. Empty means all states and territories in the inventory.
states.title: States (Optional)

title: US Dam Inventory Input
